All content HYPOTHESIS/NOT_RUN; no data claims.

lawful_categories: (a) leg-own trailing stats from completed weeks/folds (8 features)
(c) calendar/session geometry (4 features; event-blackout requires staged+sha-pinned public calendar archive)
(e) measured market-state variables from the 9 runnable J-REGIME_OPT gate rows (RV percentile, VIX regime, Hurst/AR(1), HMM/GARCH, ATR-ratio/BBW, weekday/season, cross gates, vol-target overlay)
forbidden: future data of any kind (fail-closed BLOCKED_STALE)
current-fold realized PnL of any leg or the portfolio (fold-lock law)
any feature whose value depends on test-fold outcomes (thresholds frozen at Stage-B from TRAIN only)
unevidenced inputs (consensus vintages, CB texts, yields/swaps incl. SOFR and SONIA, equities, non-evidenced commodities, option quotes, OI, positioning, sentiment)

sequencing.wave_1: exact-arm dry-runs (no PnL per RGC law): all 75 T1 + 9 VOLPROF class candidates = 84 runs; all four slates' T1 legs included
sequencing.wave_2: T2 defaults-registration pass (one frozen value per named parameter, no grids) for all 75 T2 rows + the section-1.1 pre-trade-computability test (USDJPY-S020 MOF exclusion DROPPED via MECHANIZATION_DEVIATION; USDJPY-S086 zone filter bound to price-level form) + calendar-archive staging + G-PIT-V3 daily-clock staleness adaptation for oil consumers; then dry-run slate T2 legs (G1 4, G2 3, G4 4)

sequencing.first_fold_report: per candidate: compiled y/n, param digest, decision counts vs 20/3/100 floors (typed NOT_RUN_THIN), fill counts, cost-bill decomposition at x1.0/x1.5, staleness/UNAVAILABLE counts, GROSS-vs-NET gap, MECHANIZATION_DEVIATION flags (USDJPY-S020 deviation visible in arm identity, never silent); per slate: TRAIN-fold pairwise PnL correlation matrix, co-loss census, order-overlap, netting collisions; NO test-fold numbers (none exist), no Sharpe as evidence, no ancestry exclusion

key_decisions: Triage judged from the corpus rule text at each row's source_ref (all 294 read, incl. the 5 addendum rows), not from the one-line census mechanism summary alone; rubric + calendar conventions + pre-trade-computability convention published so the judgment is auditable and rows can move tier without re-reading the corpus.

Calendar convention split into 4 classes: tzdata geometry free; holiday calendars = skip/filter keeps tier, arming caps at T2; release DATE calendars cap at T2 with staging prerequisite; VALUE archives (consensus, text, OI, auction tails, MOF amounts) = T3. Rationale: dates are deterministic and trivially verifiable; values carry sourcing/vintage discipline the program has not discharged.

Pre-trade computability convention (remediation F-10): filters conditioning on ex-post-known events are not implementable live even with a perfect archive; USDJPY-S020's corpus MOF-intervention exclusion is DROPPED in its preregistered defaults with a MECHANIZATION_DEVIATION label (tier kept T2 - the price trigger is complete; the deviation is disclosed in the triage reason and must surface in the arm identity); USDJPY-S086's intervention-zone check held to the computable price-level form. Distinction: event-date filters are not computable pre-trade; static price-band zone filters are.
Unevidenced couplings are declared-off rather than blocking; only unevidenced elements in the Signal/Trade lines park a row. Convention disclosed in section 1.1 as a judgment call.

FX-spot-only vehicle law applied: oil/gold/equity inputs may be signals, never execution legs - USDCAD-S062/S081 two-leg oil pairs trades parked on vehicle grounds while USDCAD-S013 single-leg residual fade survives; addendum row EURUSD-S082 parked partly because its EURCHF vehicle needs the missing USDCHF panel.

SOFR re-classified UNEVIDENCED (remediation F-5): the pr12a100k PIT dossier pins only EFFR/VIX/Brent-WTI; SOFR liveness was re-checked but no dossier pins it. All evidence claims and the FORBIDDEN list now read 'only EFFR/VIX/Brent-WTI'; the 3 SOFR-dependent candidate rows (GBPUSD-S006/S031/S040) departed the candidate set when A1's fixed ladder re-classified them PIT-blocked, so no tier relied on the erroneous SOFR-evidenced claim.

D-CARRY_TERM entirely parked (0/11 post-delta): no rate series beyond EFFR is evidenced; one owner rates-dossier action (SOFR + SONIA + AUD/CA/JP benchmarks) unblocks up to 11 candidate rows plus the 3 departed.

J-REGIME_OPT reframed: its 9 runnable rows are meta-gates/allocators, absorbed as the policy ON/OFF feature set (section 3e) rather than as PnL legs; the 20 J rows needing option/rate quotes stay parked.

Four slates designed as measurement vehicles, not selections: G2 deliberately concentrates the session-class correlation risk VOLPROF spec section 11 flags, so Stage-B measures it on TRAIN instead of assuming it away; G3 instantiates the VOLPROF section 11 trend-complement prior with anchors on different pairs/clocks; slate label mixes reported (FHN-dominated, honestly); addendum rows did not enter any slate.

ONOFF_NET_CONTRIBUTION defined per fold with its sign, but always accompanied by delta_vs_b1 (PnL+costs, what P1 consumes) and the p90 switching ladder (P6d) + x1.5 stress (P6a), so a policy cannot claim timing credit for netting savings.

Switch costs priced at the measured per-hour spread cell of the ACTUAL fill hour + U3 band of that hour (spread charged exactly once per FILL_ACCOUNTING_SPEC section 2); counterfactual twins are append-only journal rows of a B1 shadow book, never edits.
Sequencing breadth-first: all 75 T1 rows dry-run before any diagnostic PnL exists (RGC no-PnL dry-run law); T3 at zero runs doubles as the owner-unblock map.

Addendum deltas triaged from corpus source text: USDCAD-S024 (T2 - price-only squeeze core, catalyst accounting declared-off), USDCAD-S048 (T2 - August fade with the text-required news kill-switch bound to the only stageable proxy, unscheduled-headline kill declared-off with disclosure), USDJPY-S012 (T2 - the F0-court row re-admitted as PRICE_PLUS_CALENDAR, label F0_INDIVIDUAL_REJECT, no-Japan-news gate = class-iii staging), EURUSD-S082 and USDJPY-S028 (T3 - EURCHF vehicle missing / news-tag gap classifier in the Signal line).
known_limitations: The triage is a document judgment over rule text, not a measurement; two reviewers applying the published rubric could move individual rows one tier - the per-row reasons make each call revisable.

Complementarity reasoning in section 2 is PRIOR ONLY, to be measured on TRAIN folds post-registration; under the program's own prior (11/11 codified rules dead, every adjacent FX skeleton dead) the expected per-leg outcome is negative and the slates are built so a negative per-leg result still leaves the owner's portfolio timing question measurable.

Derived-cross inputs (EURGBP exact; AUDJPY/CADJPY/EURAUD/EURCAD/GBPCAD/AUDCAD at H1+) are signal-only constructions from evidenced panels; execution stays on the 5 majors via netting - the AUDUSD H1 x USDJPY M1 cross inherits any H1-pair timing coarseness.

WTI/Brent consumers (6 runnable rows) need a declared daily-clock staleness adaptation of the frozen G-PIT-V3 weekly rule (consume only observations published before the decision instant) - conservative, cannot leak, but changes trigger timing vs the corpus text.

Event-blackout and holiday features (section 3c) are lawful in kind but require the historical public-calendar archive to be staged and sha-pinned first; until then only 2 slate legs (USDJPY-S047, EURUSD-S041) are affected and both have declared-off fallbacks.

USDJPY-S020's MECHANIZATION_DEVIATION means its Stage-A arm identity will not match the corpus text verbatim (MOF exclusion dropped); the deviation is preregistered, labeled and must be reported in every diagnostic table - it is not silently 'fixed'.
The C2 Mon-Thu roll-cell correction (Lane D flag) is an open program-wide dependency for any rollover-window fills; all four slates avoid 21:00-23:00 UTC fills by design.

No backtest, no PnL, no correlation measurement, no decision-count measurement was run; no data claim is made anywhere in the two artifacts; Stage-A/Stage-B/Stage-C numbers referenced are budget arithmetic, not results.
incidents: I-R1 LOW (label-semantics finding, verdict-neutral, confirmed by A1's regeneration): the eligibility ladder's pit_class keyword classifier lets rows whose mechanisms consume unevidenced cross-asset inputs (copper, Nikkei, gilts, CME OI, risk reversals, COFER, FXA AUM, EURCHF/news tags...) reach EXPLORATORY_CANDIDATE as PRICE_ONLY because required_pit_data strings did not contain the keyword set. The ladder's EXPLORATORY_CANDIDATE badge therefore does NOT certify input availability - this triage is the binding layer that does. 144 rows are parked on exactly this gap. A1's classifier fix (F-4) moved 5 rows in and 3 out; the residual gap is the reason this lane's input-evidence table governs over pit_class.

I-R2 LOW->RESOLVED (SONIA/SOFR misclassification, remediation F-5): GBPUSD-S006/S031/S040 reached MACRO_PIT_EVIDENCED_PARTIAL via the 'sofr' keyword, but neither leg of the SONIA-SOFR differential is pinned by any PIT dossier (only EFFR/VIX/Brent-WTI are; SOFR liveness-checked only). All three rows were T3 in r0 on the SONIA leg; A1's regenerated ladder now PIT-blocks all three, removing them from the candidate set. Lane R artifacts corrected everywhere to 'only EFFR/VIX/Brent-WTI evidenced'.

I-R3 MEDIUM->RESOLVED-BY-ANNOTATION (pre-trade-lookahead trap, remediation F-10): USDJPY-S020's corpus MOF-intervention exclusion conditions on unscheduled, ex-post-disclosed events - not computable pre-trade even with a complete archive. Resolution per dispatch recommendation: row kept T2 with preregistered defaults BOUND to drop the MOF filter, carrying the MECHANIZATION_DEVIATION label in the triage reason, the section-1.1 convention, the section-5.2 defaults pass and the section-5.3 first-fold report. USDJPY-S086's intervention-zone check is distinguished (computable price-level form) and its declared default is bound accordingly.

No git operations, no network, no S1, no writes outside the two declared outputs plus this handoff; .venv/bin/python used only for TSV statistics/joining; corpus, census, PIT dossier, eligibility table and audit JSONs read-only.
